PLACEHOLDER — hk 2141 (operator r1027cmdcode)

The Command Code (cmd v1.88.0) usage/rate-limit wording is not known yet.

`cmd --help` documents `/usage` (credits, plan, and usage metrics) but names no
limit text, and no desk capture has provided the screen or exit text a limited
run prints. Per the hk 2141 brief the wording may only come from `cmd --help`
or a capture the desk provides — a limit must never be triggered on purpose.

Until a capture lands, `scopefuel observe commandcode-limit` accepts only
typed values (--reset/--observed/--rung/--source) exactly like
`observe devin-free-limit`, and tests exercise the store through those typed
values — never a real cmd run. When the wording arrives, the observer parser
(wrk side, hk 2140) consumes the captured text; this file is replaced by that
capture.
